title: Prefill: KDA chain (core + conv + gated o_norm)
shape: NVFP4 1-node DEP16 slice (L24 view: 18 KDA + 6 DSA + 23 MoE layers), F16K at L78K, ms per forward
basis: MEASURED in-step NVFP4 baseline (INFRA 17:48, wzhao/k31ws-int b31121cf56, runs/INFRA/step_p/int-b31121c-nv-f16f8-prof; measured/20261118-1805-nvfp4-prefill.json); achievable = nvfp4_modelopt model at the same slice
gap_analysis: Measured per layer at F16K (3 x 5461, 96 heads, FP32 state): 1119 us = FlashKDA recurrence K2 394 + prepare K1 299 + fused Q|K|V conv 219 + gated o_norm/MXFP8 204 (+3 beta transpose); x69 = 77.2 ms vs model 17.4 ms (4.4x). F8K: 581 us/layer (K2 208, K1 153, conv 113, o_norm 104). Per kernel vs its own HBM floor: conv moves 2.4 GB (~11 TB/s, at its floor, only fusion helps); o_norm moves ~1.0 GB in 204 us (~5 TB/s, 2.4x its floor); K1 moves ~2.45 GB (q,k,g in; three bf16 [T,H,D] workspaces out) in 299 us (~8 TB/s); K2 reads ~1.6 GB and is compute/latency bound on legacy warp MMA (FP32 register state, 16-token chunks, 341 serial chunks per (seq, head), 288 items over 212 SMs). The model prices conv and o_norm with zero activation bytes and the core as one 2.0 GB pass, so the gap is (1) unfused conv/o_norm passes (~420 us), (2) the K1->K2 workspace round trip (~2.4 GB), (3) K2 throughput.
inefficiencies: MEASURED: separate conv pass 219 us/layer (2.4 GB, at HBM rate)
MEASURED: o_norm + MXFP8 kernel 204 us/layer at ~5 TB/s (2.4x its HBM floor)
MEASURED: K1 prepare 299 us/layer writes ~1.2 GB of workspace that K2 re-reads
MEASURED: K2 recurrence 394 us/layer (stock build); in-tree split build full width 495, VD64 x2/SM 422 (cause of stock vs split difference not yet identified)
HYPOTHESIS: K2 bound by legacy mma.sync throughput + per-chunk fragment transposes (ncu not available in the image)
rubin_features: bulk tensor copies (TMA) for the FusedConv raw Q|K|V boxes (exp branch)
packed FP32 FMA/mul/add (fma.rn.f32x2) in the conv + SiLU (IEEE per lane)

planned: tcgen05 MMA with the FP32 state as a TMEM accumulator (kind::f16 BF16 operands, stock FlashKDA chunk-16 math) for the 96-head recurrence; persistent TMA-ring K1; larger per-SM shared memory for multi-tile K1 rings
plan: DONE (landing): HBM-rate gated o_norm + MXFP8 kernel: -59 us/layer F16K (-4.1 ms/forward)

K1 prepare (299 us, ~8 TB/s, latency-bound single-shot CTAs): persistent multi-tile K1 with a TMA ring over (tile, head) items -> its ~2.45 GB floor (~200 us); then FusedConv pays (exp branch has the bitwise conv-in-load code)

K2 recurrence (394 us): tcgen05 rewrite keeping FlashKDA chunk-16 operands (K1 workspace unchanged): S^T[V,K] FP32 in TMEM/registers, per chunk M=128 (V) x N=32 (kd|qd) x K=128 MMA for k.S/q.S, INV/Mqk 128x16x16, state update 128x128x16 into a separate TMEM accumulator then fma(S, g, P) (stock rounding); 288 items over 212 SMs -> persistent grid with (seq, head, v-half) work items
Overlap K1 with K2 (per-tile ready flags, K2 high priority): hides K1 under the compute-bound recurrence and keeps the workspace in L2
Model check: core_prefill t_ach 167 us assumes 2.0 GB at 12 TB/s with all 288 recurrences overlapped; the serial chunk walk (341 x 16-token steps) needs <= 0.49 us per chunk-step per SM pair to fit
